answer: The fable of cheap identities collapses once a fake node must burn real capital, and a crystal record of every attestation makes duplicate personas visible. Sybil resistance can come from staking identity in a public ledger: each agent must lock a bond that decays if it stays silent. A whisper of a new agent spreads through peer vouching, so a swarm of clones cannot earn trust without costly, traceable stake. Attackers pay per identity, and the cost scales faster than the benefit. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
